final: WITH g AS (SELECT GenreId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS ap, AVG(Bytes*1.0/Milliseconds) AS ar FROM Track GROUP BY GenreId), o AS (SELECT AVG(ar) AS oa FROM g WHERE ar IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(g.ap) AS avg_price, AVG(g.ar) AS avg_ratio, AVG(g.ar - o.oa) AS avg_diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE g.ar > o.oa
